text:
Jordan Reyes: Need a 1-page compliance one-pager for field teams. Super scannable, single column. Audience: security/compliance reviewers + platform buyers. Aim: crib-sheet they can send in intro emails.
Priya Nandakumar: Keep it lean: 30s elevator, 3 micro-sections (security controls, SLA options, deployment modes), 2 benchmark callouts, and exact SDR routing labels.
Lucas Chen: For benchmarks, let's use a small Q&A sample workload. Suggest wording: 'Sample workload (dev Q&A): Hosted p95 ~200ms, Dedicated p95 ~70ms; caching + batching can reduce effective cost up to 2.2x on reuse-heavy traffic.' Mark numbers as 'illustrative sample'.
Jordan Reyes: Good. Elevator line draft: "Predictable inference economics for regulated teams: consistent latency, transparent unit costs, and deployable controls for compliance." Shorten if needed.
Rita (legal): Don't promise hard SLA numbers. Use "SLA-backed latency targets available with Dedicated". Add link to SLA page and a short legal-approved data handling line: "Data isolation per deployment; KMS & HSM integrations; audit logs available per contract." Keep it under one sentence.
Priya Nandakumar: SDR routing labels to include verbatim for Ops: inbound:compliance -> field-sales, inbound:gov -> gov-sales, inbound:private-deploy -> enterprise-deploy-team. Use exactly those tags in the brief footer.
Lucas Chen: Design notes: single-sided US letter, top band with logo and a pill reading 'For compliance teams', include a tiny 2-box diagram (hosted vs private) and a CTA: 'Request a tailored deployment assessment' with a short link. Sam can create PNG.
Sam (design): I can mock within 24h. Uploading template here once ready.
deploy-bot: Uploaded file: https://files.redwood.ai/marketing/onepagers/compliance-onepager-v2.png
Rita (legal): Also flag any statements about "guaranteed uptime". Use "SLA-backed uptime & latency available" instead. I'll review final copy once Ben/Priya send it.
Jordan Reyes: Action items: Priya to finalize copy + SDR labels, Lucas to finalize the benchmark bullets with 'illustrative' tag, Sam to drop design PNG, Rita to sign off final legal blurb. I will assemble final PDF for field handoff. Target: ship to field by next Tue. :rocket:
